result.detail: 13,997 of 19,250 kinase phenotype rows (72.7%) are recorded in a disease the target is already associated with and could restate the pair; dropping them leaves 4,972 distinct gene-phenotype edges. Cold AUPRC still rises 0.2529 to 0.3406 (+0.088) and micro 0.4031 to 0.4452, so the gain is phenotype similarity rather than the same clinical cohort.
